# Flizk

> Flizk is a healthcare technology company that builds software platforms for clinics. Its product DentXOne is cloud-based dental clinic management software for dental practices in Chennai, Tamil Nadu and across India, with patient records, dental charting, appointments, billing and WhatsApp appointment reminders.

## Product

- [DentXOne](https://flizk.com/products/dentxone): Overview of the dental clinic management platform — patients, appointments, treatments, billing and WhatsApp reminders.
- [Dental clinic software in Chennai](https://flizk.com/dental-clinic-software-chennai): DentXOne for Chennai and Tamil Nadu dental clinics.
- [Dental clinic software in Madurai](https://flizk.com/dental-clinic-software-madurai): DentXOne for Madurai clinics and nearby towns.
- [Dental clinic software in Coimbatore](https://flizk.com/dental-clinic-software-coimbatore): DentXOne for Coimbatore practices.
- [Dental clinic software in Virudhunagar](https://flizk.com/dental-clinic-software-virudhunagar): DentXOne for Virudhunagar district clinics.
- [Dental clinic software in Kanyakumari](https://flizk.com/dental-clinic-software-kanyakumari): DentXOne for Kanyakumari district clinics and branches.
- [WhatsApp appointment reminders](https://flizk.com/whatsapp-appointment-reminders): Appointment booking and automated WhatsApp reminders to reduce no-shows.
- [Queue-based appointments](https://flizk.com/features/queue-based-appointments): Token-numbered live patient queue per specialty, check-in, doctor claim, emergency flag and follow-ups.
- [Dental charting](https://flizk.com/features/dental-charting): Interactive FDI tooth chart with per-tooth diagnosis, treatment and surfaces, for adult, mixed and children's dentition.
- [Multi-clinic management](https://flizk.com/features/multi-clinic-management): Run several clinic branches from one account with a clinic switcher, per-clinic schedules and an all-clinics rollup (Network plan).
- [Lab work tracking](https://flizk.com/features/lab-work-tracking): Track dental lab cases from dispatch to fitting, with vendors, remakes and payables.
- [Role management](https://flizk.com/features/role-management): Permission matrix for tenant admin, clinic admin, doctor, reception and accountant roles, with per-clinic overrides.
- [Digital prescriptions](https://flizk.com/features/digital-prescriptions): Write, amend and print prescriptions from the visit, with a drug catalogue, free-text medicines and allergy warnings.
- [Pricing](https://flizk.com/pricing): DentXOne plans; contact Flizk for a demo or a custom quote.
